# NoMissCooldown

**Category:** Combat  
**Aliases:** NoClickDelay, NoHitDelay, NoMissCooldown

## What it does

NoMissCooldown gives you finer control over what happens when you swing and miss an attack in Minecraft 1.9+ combat. Normally, missing a hit triggers a brief cooldown before you can deal full damage again — this module lets you suppress that penalty or stop the swing packet from being sent in the first place.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/combat/nomisscooldown). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
